sourceTitle: North Dakota Game and Fish, 2026 Deer Hunting Proclamation (web text)
sourceQuote: Deer Bow | Statewide | Sept. 4 (12 noon) | Jan. 3 | – Any deer is legal. No unit restrictions. Orange clothing required of all bow hunters and those accompanying apprentice license holders during Deer Gun season. | – Restricted to type of deer described on license.
notes: Nonresidents may hunt only on private land (excluding PLOTS) for the first 9 1/2 days; from Sept. 14 they may hunt public land too. Nonresident any-deer bow licenses are issued by lottery. The proclamation prints month and day only; years assigned for the 2026-27 season.
